details.description:
India’s favourite Masala Noodles, MAGGI 2-minute Noodles, now comes with the goodness of Iron. Each portion (70g) of MAGGI Masala Noodles provides you with 15% of your daily Iron requirement (*as per the Daily Dietary Allowances for an Adult Sedentary Male (ICMR 2010). Containing your favourite masala taste, MAGGI noodles are made with the choicest quality spices. Make your bowl of MAGGI even better by chopping up some vegetables, dropping in an egg or throwing in your favourite ingredients.
May contain Milk solids, Mustard and Soya

Why Maggi Special
Chicken65 Noodles? Chicken 65 is one of the most loved chicken dishes of India.
Inspired by the masalas of this popular dish, our in-house experts created
Special Chicken65 Masala- a blend of 19 spices and herbs that give your
favourite Maggi® a spicy twist. How to enjoy a delicious recipe with a great
taste? Break the noodle cake into 4 parts. Add noodles and the tastemaker to
210 ml. (approx. 1.5 teacups) of boiling water. Cook for 2 minutes in an open
pan. Stir occasionally. Do not drain the remaining water. Hold for 1 min after
cooking. Serve hot. Enjoy your Maggi® noodles (steamed, dried and fried) and
consume a variety of other foods like vegetables, fruits and milk.
Had an amazing and
magical Maggi experience? Drop a review in the feedback section!

In a pressure cooker, heat oil and add the peppercorns, cinnamon, cloves, cardamom, onion, ginger, garlic and green chillies. Fry until the onions are soft.

Serve hot with bread or Malabar parottas.
